
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; padding: 1em; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; word-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在企业应用开发中，将数据库查询结果导出为 PDF 格式是常见的报表需求。PDF 具备格式固定、跨平台兼容、便于归档分发等特性，非常适合用于业务数据的正式输出。本文介绍一种基于 Free Spire.XLS for .NET 免费库的实现方式，通过「数据库 → DataTable → Excel 工作表 → PDF」的路径完成数据导出，全程无需依赖 Microsoft Office 环境。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">一、实现思路与技术路径</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">整体实现分为三个核心阶段：</span></p>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">数据读取</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：使用 ADO.NET 连接数据库，执行 SQL 查询并将结果集填充到 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">DataTable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象中</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">数据写入</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：调用 Free Spire.XLS 的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">InsertDataTable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 方法，将 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">DataTable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 批量写入 Excel 工作表</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">格式转换</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：通过内置转换引擎将工作表直接输出为 PDF 文件</span></li>
</ol>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">该方案的优势在于利用 Excel 作为中间载体，可以灵活设置表头样式、列宽、边框等格式，再统一转换为 PDF，相比直接绘制 PDF 表格，开发效率更高。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">二、环境准备</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.1 安装依赖包</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Visual Studio 的 NuGet 包管理器中安装以下两个包：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">表格处理库：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">FreeSpire.XLS</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">SQL Server 数据提供程序：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Microsoft.Data.SqlClient</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">（若使用其他数据库，替换为对应驱动包即可）</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">包管理器控制台安装命令：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-powershell" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">Install-Package FreeSpire.XLS
Install-Package Microsoft.Data.SqlClient
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.2 引入命名空间</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在代码文件头部引入所需命名空间：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Xls;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.Data;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.Drawing;
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.3 版本说明</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">本文使用的免费版本支持基础的 Excel 编辑与 PDF 转换能力，免费版存在页数限制，PDF 输出仅转换前 3 页内容，适合小规模数据报表场景。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">三、完整代码实现</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以下示例演示从 SQL Server 数据库读取产品表数据，写入 Excel 并设置基础样式，最终导出为 PDF 文件的完整流程。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3.1 数据库连接与数据查询</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;summary&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> 从数据库查询数据并填充到 DataTable</span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;/summary&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;param name="connectionString"&gt;</span>数据库连接字符串<span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;/param&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;param name="sqlQuery"&gt;</span>查询 SQL 语句<span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;/param&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;returns&gt;</span>填充后的 DataTable<span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;/returns&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-function" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">private</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">static</span> DataTable <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">GetDataFromDatabase</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> connectionString, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> sqlQuery</span>)</span>
{
    DataTable dataTable = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> DataTable();
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> (SqlConnection conn = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> SqlConnection(connectionString))<br>
{<br>
SqlDataAdapter adapter = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> SqlDataAdapter(sqlQuery, conn);<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">try</span><br>
{<br>
adapter.Fill(dataTable);<br>
}<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">catch</span> (Exception ex)<br>
{<br>
Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"数据读取失败：<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{ex.Message}</span>"</span>);<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">throw</span>;<br>
}<br>
}<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">return</span> dataTable;<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3.2 数据写入 Excel 并导出 PDF</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;summary&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> 将 DataTable 数据导出为 PDF 文件</span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;/summary&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;param name="dataTable"&gt;</span>数据源<span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;/param&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">///</span> <span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;param name="outputPdfPath"&gt;</span>PDF 输出路径<span class="hljs-doctag" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">&lt;/param&gt;</span></span>
<span class="hljs-function" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">void</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">ExportDataTableToPdf</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">DataTable dataTable, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> outputPdfPath</span>)</span>
{
    <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 创建工作簿，using 语句自动释放资源</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> (Workbook workbook = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> Workbook())
    {
        Worksheet sheet = workbook.Worksheets[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>];
        sheet.Name = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据报表"</span>;
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 将 DataTable 批量写入工作表，参数：数据源、是否显示列名、起始行、起始列</span><br>
sheet.InsertDataTable(dataTable, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>);</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 自动获取已填充数据的单元格区域，无需手动计算行列</span><br>
CellRange usedRange = sheet.AllocatedRange;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 设置表头样式（第一行）</span><br>
CellRange headerRange = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, dataTable.Columns.Count];<br>
headerRange.Style.Font.IsBold = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>;<br>
headerRange.Style.Font.Size = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">11</span>;<br>
headerRange.Style.Color = Color.LightSkyBlue;<br>
headerRange.Style.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignType.Center;<br>
headerRange.Style.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignType.Center;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 快速设置全数据区域边框（外边框+内部分隔线）</span><br>
usedRange.BorderAround(LineStyleType.Thin);<br>
usedRange.BorderInside(LineStyleType.Thin);</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 设置全数据区域居中对齐</span><br>
usedRange.Style.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignType.Center;<br>
usedRange.Style.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignType.Center;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 仅对有数据的列执行自适应，提升性能</span><br>
usedRange.AutoFitColumns();</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 页面设置：表格内容在页面中水平居中</span><br>
sheet.PageSetup.CenterHorizontally = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>;</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 导出为 PDF 文件</span><br>
workbook.SaveToFile(outputPdfPath, FileFormat.PDF);<br>
}<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3.3 主程序调用示例</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-function" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">void</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Main</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span>[] <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">args</span></span>)</span>
{
    <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 数据库连接字符串</span>
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> connString = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"Server=localhost\\SQLEXPRESS;Database=SalesDB;User ID=demouser;Password=YourPassword;Encrypt=true;TrustServerCertificate=true;"</span>;
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 查询 SQL</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> sql = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">@"<br>
SELECT<br>
o.OrderID AS 订单编号,<br>
c.CustomerName AS 客户名称,<br>
o.OrderDate AS 订单日期,<br>
o.TotalAmount AS 订单金额<br>
FROM Orders o<br>
JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID<br>
WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2026;<br>
"</span>;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// PDF 输出路径</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> outputPath = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">@"D:\Reports\SalesReport_2026.pdf"</span>;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">try</span><br>
{<br>
DataTable data = GetDataFromDatabase(connString, sql);<br>
ExportDataTableToPdf(data, outputPath);<br>
Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"PDF 导出成功，文件已保存至：<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{outputPath}</span>"</span>);<br>
}<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">catch</span> (Exception ex)<br>
{<br>
Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"导出流程出错：<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{ex.Message}</span>"</span>);<br>
}</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">Console.ReadKey();<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">四、PDF 输出优化建议</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.1 页面方向与尺寸</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对于列数较多的宽表，建议设置为横向打印以避免内容被截断：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">sheet.PageSetup.Orientation = PageOrientationType.Landscape;
sheet.PageSetup.PaperSize = PaperSizeType.PaperA4;
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.2 缩放适配</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">开启页面自适应，确保所有列能在一页宽度内显示：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">workbook.ConverterSetting.SheetFitToWidth = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>;
workbook.ConverterSetting.SheetFitToPage = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">false</span>;
</code></pre>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 0; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以上方案提供了一条清晰的数据库到 PDF 的导出路径，代码结构简单且易于扩展。开发者可在此基础上根据业务需求增加表头合并、条件格式、合计行等高级报表特性。</span></p></section>
